text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Adjusting the data reference sources was 
definitely the right call. Precision has 
improved.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's your problem, starin' like 
that?
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just as calculated. That proves I 
was right to some extent— but it's still 
far from enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I'll deliver even more overwhelming 
results and silence all those people 
spouting useless noise."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Annoying. You're just stating the obvious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We've got new data. When there's a chance 
to improve accuracy, you can't just space 
out, can ya?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what the execution results will 
be next time... Now this is gettin' fun.
